from pathlib import Path
import re
errors = []
count = 0
for page in Path('docs').rglob('*.md'):
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)', page.read_text()):
        if '://' in target:
            continue
        filename, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        dest = page.parent / filename if filename else page
        count += 1
        if not dest.is_file():
            errors.append(f'{page}: missing {target}')
        elif anchor:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#+\s+(.+)$', dest.read_text(), re.M)
            anchors = [re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings]
            if anchor not in anchors:
                errors.append(f'{page}: missing heading {target}')
if errors:
    raise SystemExit('\n'.join(errors))
print(f'Checked {count} local documentation links; all resolve.')

from pathlib import Path
import re
count = 0
for page in Path('docs').rglob('*.md'):
    content = re.sub(r'`[^`\n]*`', '', page.read_text())
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)', content):
        if '://' in target:
            continue
        filename, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        dest = page.parent / filename if filename else page
        assert dest.is_file(), (page, target)
        if anchor:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#+\s+(.+)$', dest.read_text(), re.M)
            anchors = [re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings]
            assert anchor in anchors, (page, target)
        count += 1
print(f'All {count} local documentation links and heading targets resolve (excluding inline code examples).')
